title: Visualization Fidelity Atlas Bundle
source_documents: Picking the Right Visualization - Why Pie Charts are Undesirable.md
Below is a research-grounded version of the argument.md

interaction_contract.selection: Visual-form selection, exemplar selection, and Reserved-group visibility remain distinct, visible states.
interaction_contract.exchange: Paste and local-file routes share one size-limited interactive-render validation and commit path. Renderable collections, closed references, and finite chart values are checked; schema-optional recommendation scores appear as Not scored.
interaction_contract.rendering: Accepted Atlas strings remain inert text in controls, HTML, and SVG output.
interaction_contract.recovery: A rejected import leaves the last accepted Atlas and view state active.
interaction_contract.copy: Prompt, Atlas JSON, and JSON-LD actions expose selectable content together with clipboard status.
interaction_contract.semantic_twin: The JSON-LD graph is rebuilt from the accepted Atlas and current view state.
